profile.summary:
Hi! My name is Samantha. This past fall, I graduated from California State University, Long Beach with a B.S. in Computer Science. Yay! And I've recently started a new Software Engineer role with Lark @ByteDance. 

I believe in meditation, fashion as an art, and the power of creation. I hope to make beautiful things that inspire and empower others.

Problem Solver
Yogi

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked as a Full Stack Engineer on an Agile XP team, practicing test-driven development, continuous integration, pair programming, and retrospectives.

Collaborated with Product Designers and Creative teams to implement new features for product pages, all to improve user engagement and overall experience.

Led the design and implementation of a new Bundle Toast feature. The goal of the project was to engage with our users in a fun and playful way, showing their progression towards achieving a bundle discount. It uses modern technologies such as Ruby, GraphQL, Apollo, and React.

volunteerExperiences.description: Help to organize fundraising events for the shelter.  Sort donated supplies.  Work in the kitchen, preparing and serving dinner.

Provided friendly and caring service, such as delivering flowers and mail to patient rooms, making sure each patient was comfortable.  

Answered call lights, paging nurses when necessary.  

Assisted patients at information desk, escorting​ them to designated area.

projects.title: Life Guru
projects.description:
An open, advice forum where people can post their life problems and seek guidance from "life gurus" of the community. 

Implemented a GraphQL API using Apollo, and front end is written in React and Emotion.

projects.title: Study Chums
projects.description:
A social networking web application with the goal of connecting students with similar majors or interests so they may form study groups or work on their next big project. A fun, interesting approach to educational sites--modeled from Tinder (swipe left, swipe right construct). 

 Implemented using Cloud Firestore, Node.js, Javascript, HTML, CSS.
